title: Sepsis-3: qSOFA bedside criteria
applicability: Adults with suspected infection outside ICU
text: qSOFA identifies patients with suspected infection who may have a higher risk of poor outcomes. Its criteria are respiratory rate at least 22/min, altered mentation, and systolic blood pressure at most 100 mm Hg. It is supporting context, not a standalone diagnosis, comprehensive screening rule, or automated treatment order.

title: Sepsis-3 consensus definition
locator: JAMA 315(8), pp. 801-810; New Terms and Definitions
text: The consensus defines sepsis as life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to infection. It operationalises organ dysfunction as an acute SOFA increase of 2 or more. The copilot must present this as retrieved evidence, not diagnose sepsis.

title: National Early Warning Score 2
locator: RCP NEWS2 report, 2017; scoring charts and Scale 2 guidance
applicability: Adults; follow local adoption, exclusions and complete RCP chart
text: NEWS2 standardises assessment and response to acute illness using respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, supplemental oxygen, systolic blood pressure, pulse, consciousness or new confusion, and temperature. The RCP report includes a second oxygen-saturation scale for selected patients with hypercapnic respiratory failure. Use the complete published chart and local escalation policy; this summary is not a scoring calculator.

title: NICE NG51 suspected sepsis (superseded)
locator: NICE NG51 guideline overview and update history
applicability: Historical UK guideline; use current population-specific NICE guidance instead
text: NICE NG51 covered recognition, assessment and early management of suspected sepsis. NICE states that NG51 was replaced by population-specific guidance NG253, NG254 and NG255. Retain this record for historical provenance only; do not treat it as current guidance.

title: NICE NG253 suspected sepsis in people aged 16 or over
locator: NICE NG253 guideline overview; recognition, assessment and early management
applicability: People aged 16 or over who are not and have not recently been pregnant
text: NICE NG253 covers recognition, assessment and early management of suspected sepsis in people aged 16 or over who are not and have not recently been pregnant. It replaced part of NG51 and was published on 19 November 2025. Apply the current NICE recommendations, patient context and local pathway; this summary is not an executable protocol.

title: NICE NG254 suspected sepsis in under 16s
text: NICE NG254 covers recognition, assessment and early management of suspected sepsis in people under 16. It is population-specific guidance that replaced part of NG51. Apply the complete current guideline and local paediatric pathway; adult criteria must not be substituted.

title: NICE NG255 suspected sepsis in pregnant or recently pregnant people
text: NICE NG255 covers recognition, assessment and early management of suspected sepsis in pregnant or recently pregnant people. It is population-specific guidance that replaced part of NG51. Apply the complete current guideline and local maternity pathway; general adult criteria must not be substituted.
